description: Single user, single host, single memory backend. 5 questions, ~2 min to complete.

questions.prompt: What should I call this AugmentIQ setup? (e.g., 'personal', 'work-research', 'team-projects')
questions.why_we_ask: Used for the timeline prefix and the config filename. Anything readable works.

questions.prompt: Which memory backend are you using?
questions.why_we_ask: Determines where records are stored. For individual use, Obsidian (local Markdown) is the simplest. Pick 'custom' only if you have an AugmentIQ+ MCP server running.
questions.validation: one of: obsidian, mem0, reme, hermes_native, custom

options.label: Obsidian (local Markdown vault) — recommended for individuals
mem0 (cloud memory layer) — recommended if you already use mem0
ReMe (file-based, versioned) — recommended if you need audit history
Hermes native MEMORY.md + USER.md — recommended for Hermes users
Custom (AugmentIQ+ MCP server) — recommended for serious / enterprise / local-first use

questions.prompt: Where is the memory backend located?
questions.why_we_ask: The Skill needs to know the path or URL of your backend. For Obsidian, this is your vault directory. For mem0, this is the API URL. For Custom, this is the MCP server endpoint.
questions.validation: filesystem path or URL; leave blank for auto-detect

questions.prompt: Do you want classification applied automatically?
questions.why_we_ask: If yes, AugmentIQ tags each record with public / internal / confidential / restricted based on its content (using PII detection). If no, you classify manually. Recommended: yes for individuals who don't want to think about it.

On-event capture (commit, decision, etc.) requires event sources to be wired. For individuals, manual capture (`/augmentiq save`) is the simplest starting point. You can add crons later via `/augmentiq reconfigure`.

options.label: Manual only — you call /augmentiq save when you want to capture
Daily snapshot — automatic daily capture at 02:00
Daily + on-event — daily plus automatic capture on commits / decisions / etc.
